fib: ______ is used to specify the details of the work that is to be performed and any special conditions or skills involved in performing the job.
Job description
Job description is used to specify the details of the work that is to be performed and any special conditions or skills involved in performing the job.
______ is the allocation of cost of the fixed assets used in a business.
Depreciation
Depreciation is the allocation of cost of the fixed assets used in a business.
______ are the means, methods, or plans that will be used by the entrepreneur to produce appropriate product or service for the business.
marketing strategies
The marketing strategies are the means, methods, or plans that will be used by the entrepreneur to produce appropriate product or service for the business.
______ is one of the traditional methods used in evaluating investment proposals.
payback period
The payback period is one of the traditional methods used in evaluating investment proposals.
______ is a financing method involving an interest-bearing instrument.
Debt financing
Debt Financing Debt financing is a financing method involving an interest-bearing instrument.
______ is the part of the business plan that describes the venture's form of ownership - that is, proprietorship, partnership, or a corporation.
venture plan
The venture plan is the part of the business plan that describes the venture's form of ownership - that is, proprietorship, partnership, or a corporation.
______ is a discount rate where the present worth of benefits is equal to the present worth of costs.
Internal rate of return
Internal rate of return is a discount rate where the present worth of benefits is equal to the present worth of costs.
______ is the private sector's view of a project without considering the project's impact on the society.
Financial analysis
Financial analysis is the private sector's view of a project without considering the project's impact on the society.
______ is a statement that shows the receipt of cash (inflows) and the disbursement of cash (outflows).
cash flow statement
A cash flow statement is a statement that shows the receipt of cash (inflows) and the disbursement of cash (outflows).
______ is the process of dividing the market into small homogeneous groups.
Market segmentation
Market segmentation is the process of dividing the market into small homogeneous groups.
______ is the most common approach used to gather market information.
Interviewing or surveying
Interviewing or surveying is the most common approach used to gather market information.
